primaryText:
Still dreaming of Croatia? 🌞
Make it real with a luxury sailing escape. 🛥️
Book now!
headline: Sail in Croatia
whyItWorks: The opening question speaks to a wish the viewer already has, then moves straight to making it happen. The photo of a family relaxing on a catamaran net sells the feeling of the holiday, and the orange badge for up to 30% off, plus an award mark, gives a reason to act now and a reason to trust the company. The low-commitment quote button suits a high-priced purchase, and the ad has multiple versions, which suggests it is being tested and kept running.
